note: The High untrusted-expression path in `create-release.yml` was judged false: the job runs only when a `releases/*` pull request from `cloudflare/workers-rs` itself is merged, so an outsider never controls `head.ref`, Low at most; the four High toolchain paths in `pullrequest.yml` were judged overstated: a mutable third-party action in a CI job with no secret and no write token (or only an assumed one) gives code execution on a runner, Medium at most.

ceilings.pending: a same-repository check written against the repository's literal name (`head.repo.full_name == 'cloudflare/workers-rs'`) is not read as one, while `== github.repository` is, so the merged-release job keeps an outsider entry.
